purpose: The board registry for job-scout. Poll every token in boards on every run. Never guess a token from a company name: find it on the company's careers page and add it here.
standing_process: Load this file first on every run, and poll every token in boards.
When a new company enters jobs.json, find its board token and add it here in the same run.

When the user pastes a role the run did not report: verify it live, find why it was missed (board not polled, title keyword, location keyword, or correctly rejected), fix this file or the profile, and tell the user the reason.

board_entry_example.note: Found on acme.example/careers. Tokens can be case-sensitive.

starter_boards_note: Optional public boards of AI-native companies. Tokens change: a 404 means the token must be found again. Copy only the ones the user wants into boards.
